k_drain_inflight.why: SIGTERM stops new connections, finishes in-flight requests

k_drain_timeout.why: grace window for in-progress handlers during shutdown

k_lb_deregister.why: fail readiness so LB stops new traffic before drain

k_session_kill.why: admin terminates user session, not shutdown draining

k_signal_handler_kill9.why: SIGKILL no cleanup, opposite of graceful

k_worker_inflight.why: worker checks stop flag, finishes job cleanly
